item.title: PM Modi to begin his Israel visit today, defence and trade on agenda
item.description: India and Israel s relations will be upgraded to a “special strategic partnership” during Prime Minister Narendra Modi s visit, marking a “significant leap ahead” similar to Jerusalem s ties with countries such as the US and Germany, sources said here Tuesday. MORE..

item.title: Deputy Defence Minister chairs special meeting to resolve land issues faced by war heroes
item.description: A special meeting was convened under the chairmanship of the Deputy Minister of Defence, Major General Aruna Jayasekara (Retd), to discuss land-related issues identified by the Ranaviru Seva Authority affecting war heroes and their family members, and to provide prompt solutions. MORE..

item.title: “Tariffs will replace income tax, will take burden off Americans”- Trump in key speech
item.description: US President Donald Trump, during his annual State of the Union address, defended his sweeping tariffs on foreign countries, saying those who “ripped the US for years are now paying billions of dollars. MORE..

item.title: Former Head of State Intelligence Suresh Sallay arrested by CID
item.description: The Former Head of the State Intelligence Service, Major General (Retired) Suresh Sallay has been arrested by the Criminal Investigation Department (CID). MORE..

item.title: Foreign Minister Vijitha Herath to leave for Germany tomorrow
item.description: The Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism Vijitha Herath will undertake a visit to Germany from 26-27 February 2026 to participate in a series of meetings related to trade and foreign employment, pursuant to an invitation extended by the German-Asia Pacific Business Association of Germany (OAV) Bremen Chapter. MORE..

item.title: Prof. Susiripala Manawadu assumes duties as new Governor of Southern Province
item.description: Professor Susiripala Manawadu officially assumed duties as the Governor of the Southern Province this morning (25) at the Southern Province Governor s Secretariat in Galle. MORE..

item.title: UK to enforce travel permit requirement on foreign visitors
item.description: Starting on Wednesday (Feb 25), visitors to Britain from 85 countries, including Singapore, must obtain an electronic permit in advance of their trip or they will be barred from travelling, the UK interior ministry said. MORE..

item.title: Appeals Court dismisses Avant-Garde writ petitions without formal hearing
item.description: The Court of Appeal has ordered the dismissal of two writ petitions filed by Avant-Garde and its employees, without a formal hearing. MORE..

item.title: FM Vijitha Herath to undertake an official visit to Romania
item.description: The Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism, Vijitha Herath will undertake an official visit to Romania from 1–3 March, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs said in a statement. MORE..

item.title: Opposition leaders meet ex-President Ranil to coordinate strategy on national issues
item.description: A group of leaders of opposition parties held a high-level meeting with former President Ranil Wickremesinghe this morning (25) to discuss strategies for coordinated action across opposition parties. MORE..
